info.title: Becon Universal API
info.description: Use the Becon crypto payment API to inspect balances, transactions, stores, addresses, currencies, exchange rates, and sandbox test payments.

post.description: Creates a new Binance payment address in Becon.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

chain.description: Fixed target network for this preset.

external_id.description: Unique tracking value returned in callbacks.

origin_amount.description: Amount in the origin currency for automatic conversion.

origin_currency.description: Origin fiat currency, for example USD or EUR.

payment_currency.description: Token ticker to accept, for example BNB.
